item.title: 'Outline of naked woman...': WSJ report alleges Trump sent an unusual birthday letter to Epstein in 2003; US president threatens to sue, says 'not his words'
item.description: A birthday album made for Jeffrey Epstein's 50th birthday, featuring a controversial letter purportedly signed by Donald Trump, has resurfaced. The letter includes a suggestive drawing and text, which Trump vehemently denies creating, threatening a lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal. US vice president JD Vance has criticized the report.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'No gringo is going to give orders': Brazil's Lula slams US president over 50% tariff; claims Trump is 'not the emperor of the world'
item.description: Brazilian President Lula da Silva has strongly criticized US President Donald Trump's decision to impose a 50% tariff on Brazilian imports, asserting Brazil's sovereignty and rejecting foreign interference. Lula accused US tech firms of spreading misinformation and announced plans to regulate and tax them. The escalating trade dispute has boosted Lula's approval ratings as Brazil considers retaliatory measures.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Most consequential 3 seconds’: Ex-Alaska Airlines pilot recalls attempting to shut off flight’s engine mid-air; feared fatal end
item.description: Former Alaska Airlines pilot Joseph Emerson, under the influence of “magic mushrooms,” recalls pulling levers that could have cut off fuel to the engines on a flight carrying 83 passengers. Emerson, grieving a friend's death, claims he sought to "wake up" from a dissociative state. The flight safely diverted to Portland, where he was arrested.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Felix Baumgartner dies in paragliding crash - felt unwell before flight; Italy mourns
item.description: Austrian sportsman Felix Baumgartner, known for his daring feats, tragically died in a paragliding accident in Italy. He lost control of his aircraft near Porto Sant'Elpidio, crashing into a hotel swimming pool, also injuring a woman. Baumgartner, famed for his record-breaking freefall from the stratosphere in 2012, was pronounced dead at the scene after suffering cardiac arrest.

item.title: A father’s tribute: Dubai ruler Sheikh Mohammed dedicates poem to Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan on first year as Defence Minister
item.description: On the first anniversary of Sheikh Hamdan’s appointment as UAE Minister of Defence, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid honoured his son with a Nabati poem, a powerful tribute to their decades-long bond, mentorship, and shared vision. The poem underscores Sheikh Hamdan’s leadership, blending cultural heritage with confidence in the next generation shaping the nation’s future.

item.title: Watch: New footage shows Travis Decker, accused of killing 3 daughters in Washington, days before their disappearance; looked ‘nervous and fidgety’
item.description: Travis Decker, accused of killing his three daughters, was seen in police footage days before their disappearance. The video shows Decker after a car accident. The other driver described him as nervous. The girls were found dead after a visitation with Decker. Decker's abandoned vehicle had his bloody handprints. He is wanted for murder and kidnapping.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Voting age to be lowered to 16 across UK: Government
item.description: The UK government has confirmed lowering the voting age to 16 for all UK elections, aligning with Scotland and Wales, potentially adding 1.5 million young voters. Alongside this, British voters can now use UK-issued bank cards as voter ID, and stricter measures will be implemented to combat foreign donations and protect candidates from harassment.
item.dc:creator: NAOMI CANTON

item.title: Donald Trump diagnosed with chronic venous insufficiency, White House says amid speculations over bruises on his hand
item.description: Amid speculations about President Trump's bruised hand, the White House disclosed a diagnosis of a chronic, benign vein condition discovered during an examination for swollen legs. Spokesperson Karoline Leavitt attributed hand bruising to frequent handshaking and aspirin use, dismissing concerns about more serious conditions like deep vein thrombosis or arterial disease.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Fired without reason’: Who is Maurene Comey, Manhattan prosecutor who worked on Epstein files and Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs?
item.description: Maurene Comey, a federal prosecutor in Manhattan, faced termination by the US Justice Department. She is the daughter of former FBI director James Comey. The reason for her dismissal remains unclear. Comey handled high-profile cases, including those of Jeffrey Epstein and Sean "Diddy" Combs. She expressed surprise at her firing, stating she received no explanation.

item.title: ‘Could see victim under car’: Indian-origin students sentenced to 3 years in jail in Canada for hit-and-run; could face deportation
item.description: In Surrey, Canada, Gaganpreet Singh and Jagdeep Singh, two international students from India, received three-year prison sentences for a fatal hit-and-run. They struck and dragged a 47-year-old pedestrian, who later died from severe injuries. Both men pleaded guilty to multiple charges, including dangerous operation of a vehicle and failing to provide assistance. Upon release, they may face deportation.

item.description: His Highness Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan actively participated in the Abu Dhabi Summer Sports event at ADNEC, emphasizing the UAE leadership’s commitment to promoting fitness and community health. item.title: Drone hits oil field in Iraq's Kurdistan for second day
item.description: A drone loaded with explosives struck an oil field in Iraq's northern Kurdistan region on Thursday, Kurdish forces said -- the second attack in two days on the Norwegian-operated site. Similar attacks on Wednesday forced the Norwegian firm to suspend operations at the Tawke and Peshkabir oil fields.

item.title: 'Old news': Russia rolls eyes at US sanctions threat over Ukraine war; 'we don't accept threat'
item.description: Russia has downplayed the threat of new US sanctions, dismissing them as commonplace. This reaction follows President Trump's 50-day ultimatum for Russia to negotiate a peace agreement with Ukraine, coupled with a NATO-backed military aid plan for Kyiv. Trump warned of imposing tariffs on Russia’s trading partners if no deal is reached, as the conflict continues without resolution.
